REJECT
The patch only extracts the three finding loops at the top and the three report loops at the bottom; the roughly 90 lines between them (the `gatingAny` check and the nested loops that fill `dropped`, `outside`, `configDropped`, `reached` and `collected`) stay in `Js`, so the extracted parts remove only about 25–30 of the 77 points and the method is almost certainly still well above 15.
